summary: Frontend-only MVP test of ELUS (mocked, no backend). Executed full E2E flow on mobile viewport (390x844) via Playwright: splash → login → profile-type → tabs (Presença/Busca/Solicitações/Conexões/Perfil) → public profile → request access → plans → logout. All 13 critical flows from the review request work correctly. testIDs render properly as data-testid in web preview.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); useNativeDriver not supported on web (harmless, JS-driven animations work). props.pointerEvents deprecated warning. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (e.g. RadarNode shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) and remove useNativeDriver from web animations to silence console warnings. No functional impact.
Optional: replace any props.pointerEvents usage with style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: AppContext state is in-memory and resets on full reload; acceptable for MVP per requirements (mocked).
Splash auto-redirect uses router.replace('/login') even if user already logged in — fine for MVP but in future should check user state.
sendAccessRequest auto-adds toUserId to connections immediately (auto-approve demo) — matches spec.
All screens use testID consistently and React Native primitives (View/Text/TouchableOpacity). No raw text or div misuse detected.
seed_data_creation: None. MOCK_PROFILES (15 profiles) and 2 incoming requests (Rafael Lima in1, Carla Mendes in2) pre-seeded in AppContext.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is mocked-only Expo web. To test tabs, use mouse.click on bounding_box of tab label text (e.g. text=Solicitações) — the tab bar uses icons+labels and the underlying Pressable doesn't expose data-testid on the tab buttons themselves. All other interactive elements have proper testIDs. Splash auto-redirects to /login after 2.6s. Login accepts any non-empty email/password. Test credentials: teste@elus.com / qualquer123.
